about: Sarah Viera Events hosts the Weekend with Santa and Mrs. Claus at Spruce Mountain Ranch.
Proceeds support Mount Saint Vincent, and participating vendors donate their time.
The ranch is at 14771 Spruce Mountain Road in Larkspur, in the Upper Ranch.
Friday, December 4, from 5 to 8 PM is Pajamas with Santa and a Polar Express movie experience.
Doors open at 5 PM with a buffet, beverages and crafts, and a live hot chocolate pour follows at 5:15 PM.
Saturday and Sunday, December 5 and 6, from 10:30 AM to 1 PM are Brunch with Santa.
The brunch days add story time and hay rides around the property.
Every day includes live entertainment and professional photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus.
Tickets are sold by table only: $300 for 6, $400 for 8 and $500 for 10.
Each ticket price covers food, beverages, entertainment, crafts and photos.
Children 1 year and under are free.
Guests are asked to bring a new, unwrapped toy for the Mount Saint Vincent gift drive.
